# baseui

> A design system on Base UI: foundations, components and a documentation site built from its own components. Zero build, ES modules, tokens in CSS variables.

## Use

- Read `CONSTITUTION.md` before building a prototype: the design rules, and what to do when a request breaks one (warn in the answer and put a ConstitutionBanner across the top of the prototype).
- Load `tokens.css` and `src/components.css`; set `data-theme="light|dark"` on `<html>`.
- Import components from `src/index.js`.
- Every component documents its props with `describe()`; the pages below are generated from it.


## Templates

- [Templates](docs/templates/templates.md): Ready pages built from the components of the system, with mock data
- [Analytics Dashboard](docs/templates/analytics-dashboard.md): Three bands: headline tiles, then charts, then supporting tables, all read from one filter bar. A summary surface rather than a drill-down
- [Data Dashboard](docs/templates/data-dashboard.md): Comparison-heavy analytics behind a persistent filter bar: tiles that carry a sparkline and period-over-period deltas, then segmented breakdowns
- [Executive Summary Dashboard](docs/templates/executive-summary-dashboard.md): A report-shaped page: a scorecard of headline numbers with deltas and status colors, goal bars, a trend grid and a written commentary column
- [Funnel & Cohort Dashboard](docs/templates/funnel-cohort-dashboard.md): Analytics for sequence and retention: a staged funnel that reads as drop-off between steps, and a cohort matrix drawn as a heatmap
- [Portfolio Dashboard](docs/templates/portfolio-dashboard.md): Holdings at a glance: total value, an allocation breakdown, a performance line and a sortable table of positions
- [Project Status Dashboard](docs/templates/project-status-dashboard.md): Where every project stands: health by status, progress against milestones, who is blocked and what ships next
- [Service Monitoring Dashboard](docs/templates/service-monitoring-dashboard.md): Uptime and latency for a set of services: a status grid, response time charts, an incident banner and a list of recent events
- [Searchable Table](docs/templates/searchable-table.md): A flat collection with one search field above it: results narrow as you type, with an empty state when nothing matches
- [Filterable Table](docs/templates/filterable-table.md): Progressive filtering over a flat collection: filter chips that stack, a saved view and a detail panel for the selected row
- [Grouped Table](docs/templates/grouped-table.md): Rows bundled into collapsible sections with a count per group, so a long list reads as a few blocks
- [Collapsible Table](docs/templates/collapsible-table.md): Several tables on one page, each in a collapsible card with its own columns, for groups that do not share a schema
- [Inbox Table](docs/templates/inbox-table.md): A two-pane message queue: the list indexes a reading pane, and replying opens a composer that leaves the list live
- [Comparison Table](docs/templates/comparison-table.md): Candidates in the columns and criteria in grouped rows, with a pinned label column and the best value in each row marked
- [Contact Form](docs/templates/contact-form.md): A flat single-column form that mixes control types and ends on one full-width submit: no steps, no branching
- [Two-column Form](docs/templates/two-column-form.md): Fields that belong together sit side by side, with a section title for each group and one action row at the end
- [Checkout Form](docs/templates/checkout-form.md): A long sectioned form beside a summary that stays in view and recalculates as fields change
- [Checkout Wizard](docs/templates/checkout-wizard.md): Cart, order and payment as steps, with a running summary that recalculates and validation before every advance
- [Form Wizard](docs/templates/form-wizard.md): A linear form, one panel at a time, with a progress track above so every step keeps the full width; a step left broken stays flagged
- [Vertical Wizard](docs/templates/vertical-wizard.md): Steps listed down the side with the current panel beside them: completed steps stay reachable, the rest are locked
- [Inline Wizard](docs/templates/inline-wizard.md): A short flow inside a card on the page: steps swap in place, without a dialog or a new page
- [Dialog Wizard](docs/templates/dialog-wizard.md): Two to four short steps in a dialog launched from the page, which stays where it was
- [Settings Form](docs/templates/settings-form.md): One long settings page of sections, each with its fields, and a single save row that stays within reach
- [Settings Panels](docs/templates/settings-panels.md): Settings split into panels: a list of areas on the left and the chosen area on the right, saved as you go
- [Settings Dialog](docs/templates/settings-dialog.md): Preferences in a dialog with tabs, opened from the page and closed without losing the place underneath
- [Login Card](docs/templates/login-card.md): A centered card with email and password, a remembered-device switch and one primary action
- [Login Split](docs/templates/login-split.md): A sign-in form on one half and a picture with a short promise on the other
- [Login SSO](docs/templates/login-sso.md): Sign-in through identity providers first, with the password form folded under a divider
- [Kanban Board](docs/templates/kanban-board.md): Columns of cards by stage, with a count per column, avatars and labels on every card
- [File Explorer](docs/templates/file-explorer.md): A folder tree beside a file list, with breadcrumbs, a list or grid switch and a details pane for the selected file
- [Centered Hero](docs/templates/centered-hero.md): A symmetrical stack: headline, a short blurb and two actions, resting on one wide picture with nothing on the flanks
- [Gallery Hero](docs/templates/gallery-hero.md): The same centered stack, resolving into a grid of several pictures so the imagery reads as a set
- [Documentation Catalog](docs/templates/documentation-catalog.md): A reference landing that is pure wayfinding: a banner above a grid of category cards that link into sections
- [Documentation Design](docs/templates/documentation-design.md): An article that alternates prose with live examples: a preview, a property table, paired do and don’t comparisons and a code block
- [Documentation Technical](docs/templates/documentation-technical.md): A reference article in numbered steps with code at each stage, and callout cards for prerequisites and next links
- [Order Detail](docs/templates/order-detail.md): One order in full: its status and timeline, the items, the totals, the addresses and the actions that are still possible
- [Product Detail](docs/templates/product-detail.md): A product page: gallery, price, options, an add-to-cart action, details in tabs and a rating summary
- [Work Item Detail](docs/templates/work-item-detail.md): A ticket page: title, description, activity with comments, and a side column of status, assignee, labels and dates
- [AI Chat Conversation](docs/templates/ai-chat-conversation.md): A transcript of alternating turns with rich content inline, beside a panel that holds the generated result
- [AI Chat Landing](docs/templates/ai-chat-landing.md): The empty counterpart to a transcript: one composer in the middle and suggestion chips instead of history
- [Card Grid](docs/templates/card-grid.md): A searchable grid of cards with filter tabs and a real empty state: uniform tiles, narrowing in place
- [Classic Gallery](docs/templates/classic-gallery.md): A uniform grid of equal-ratio tiles under a centered intro, with filters that narrow the set in place
- [Mixed Gallery](docs/templates/mixed-gallery.md): Tiles of different heights packed in columns, like a masonry wall, with a filter row above
- [Product Gallery](docs/templates/product-gallery.md): A storefront grid: product cards with price, badge and a rating, sorted and filtered from a toolbar
- [Side Gallery](docs/templates/side-gallery.md): A filter column on the side and a result grid beside it, with a count and a sort control above the grid
- [Top Nav](docs/templates/top-nav.md): An application frame with a top bar of destinations, an account menu and a page area below
- [Side Nav](docs/templates/side-nav.md): An application frame with a collapsible side navigation of sections and a page area beside it
- [Shell Nav](docs/templates/shell-nav.md): The frame in both shapes: a top bar on a narrow screen and a side column on a wide one, from the same destinations

## Theming

- [Theme Settings](docs/theming/theme-settings.md): The theme of this site and of your own app: the settings are applied at once and stored in a cookie on this device

## Foundations

- [All Tokens](docs/foundations/all-tokens.md)
- [Color](docs/foundations/color.md)
- [Constitution](docs/foundations/constitution.md): The design rules to follow so that an interface is at least acceptable: what to do and what not to do
- [Focus](docs/foundations/focus.md)
- [Icons](docs/foundations/icons.md): The icon catalog. Choose outline or filled, and the stroke width for outline
- [Layout](docs/foundations/layout.md)
- [Motion](docs/foundations/motion.md)
- [Radius](docs/foundations/radius.md): Corner radii: the named scale, and the custom radii that make nested corners concentric
- [Shadow](docs/foundations/shadow.md)
- [Spacing](docs/foundations/spacing.md)
- [Typography](docs/foundations/typography.md): Type styles for headings and text

## Components

- [Avatar](docs/components/avatar.md): A person or entity shown as an image, initials or a placeholder
- [Avatar Group](docs/components/avatar-group.md): A row of overlapping avatars
- [Badge](docs/components/badge.md): A compact label for a status, category or count
- [Banner](docs/components/banner.md): An inline message with a status
- [Constitution Banner](docs/components/constitution-banner.md): A strip across the top of a prototype that warns it breaks the design constitution: which rules, where, and what each one asks for. It is not dismissible
- [Breadcrumbs](docs/components/breadcrumbs.md): Links that show where the user is in a hierarchy
- [Button](docs/components/button.md): Triggers an action or navigates. A label that does not fit in the width of the button is cut with an ellipsis, never wrapped
- [Icon Button](docs/components/icon-button.md): A button with only an icon
- [Button Group](docs/components/button-group.md): Lays out the buttons of one decision: a row that wraps (horizontal) or a column in which every button fills the width (vertical). The layout is the group’s, so 
- [Card](docs/components/card.md): A container that groups related content
- [Clickable Card](docs/components/clickable-card.md): A card that acts as one link or button
- [Selectable Card](docs/components/selectable-card.md): A card that can be selected, like a checkbox
- [Collapsible](docs/components/collapsible.md): A section that expands and collapses
- [Dialog](docs/components/dialog.md): The dialog: a centered window on a wide screen and a bottom sheet on small ones, built on the Base UI Dialog. The sheet can be dragged down by its header to clo
- [Alert Dialog](docs/components/alert-dialog.md): A dialog that asks the user to confirm or cancel
- [Divider](docs/components/divider.md): A line that separates content
- [Dropdown](docs/components/dropdown.md): A menu of options that opens from any trigger. Below 768px it is a bottom sheet, as the list of a Selector is. Above, it opens over the page (drawn in the body,
- [Form](docs/components/form.md): The layout of a form: fields in rows with one gap in both directions, rows of one to four columns, and sections with a heading
- [Form Row](docs/components/form-row.md): Fields side by side with the gap of the form. Equal columns, or a ratio such as [2, 1]; one column when the form is narrower than 360px
- [Form Section](docs/components/form-section.md): A group of fields, with a heading or without one, inside a Form. The fields keep the gap of the form; when a form has sections, everything in it is in a section
- [Calendar](docs/components/calendar.md): A month grid for picking a date or a date range
- [Date Picker](docs/components/date-picker.md): A date field. It opens the calendar in a popover, and in a Dialog sheet on small screens. The field is a Text Input, so its size, variant, label and status come
- [Checkbox](docs/components/checkbox.md): A box that turns one option on or off, with an optional label. The error is text under the box: it has no outline
- [Checkbox Group](docs/components/checkbox-group.md): A group of checkboxes: the value is an array of the checked `value`s. The error is a message under the group; the boxes do not turn red
- [Number Input](docs/components/number-input.md): A text input for numbers with a minus and a plus button. It takes the props of the Text Input (variant, status, caption, prefix, suffix, floatingLabel)
- [OTP Input](docs/components/otp-input.md): A one-time code field. It checks the code through onComplete and shows the states of that check: verifying, error (the row shakes) and success. On enhanced anim
- [Radio](docs/components/radio.md): A group of radio buttons: the value is the `value` of the selected option. The error is a message under the group; the circles do not turn red
- [Rating](docs/components/rating.md): Collects a rating as stars. Only whole values can be chosen
- [Selector](docs/components/selector.md): A field, or any element, that opens a list of options: the Base UI Select in the shared field shell. Single and multiple selection; below 768px the list is a bo
- [Slider](docs/components/slider.md): Selects a number in a range, or with `range` two numbers: a lower and an upper bound
- [Switch](docs/components/switch.md): An instant on/off of an independent setting: a track, a thumb and an optional label. Several switches are independent boolean fields; to choose N of M use a Che
- [Text Input](docs/components/text-input.md): A single-line or multi-line text field with a floating label, built on the Base UI Input
- [Typeahead](docs/components/typeahead.md): A text field that suggests options as you type: the Base UI Combobox in the shared field shell. The typed text and the selected value are separate states. Below
- [Navbar](docs/components/navbar.md): The bar at the top of a mobile screen: a back button on the left, the title in the middle and up to two icon actions on the right
- [Bottom Bar](docs/components/bottom-bar.md): The bar at the bottom of a mobile screen for switching between 2 to 6 top-level sections. The active one is highlighted; it can also float above the content, li
- [Layout](docs/components/layout.md): A flex container with a consistent gap
- [Center](docs/components/center.md): Centers its content
- [Grid](docs/components/grid.md): A CSS grid with equal columns
- [Section](docs/components/section.md): A padded block with an optional maximum width
- [Link](docs/components/link.md): A hyperlink in the color of the text, underlined by default
- [List](docs/components/list.md): A vertical list of rows with an optional title and divider
- [List Item](docs/components/list-item.md): A list row: an icon or an avatar, a title with a caption, details and a control. A row with `onClick` or `items` is a button; otherwise it is plain text
- [Pagination](docs/components/pagination.md): Navigation between pages. The number of items is always the same (the first and the last page, the current one with its neighbours, and a gap on each side), so 
- [Popover](docs/components/popover.md): A floating panel anchored to a trigger. It opens over the page (drawn in the body, flipped and kept on screen), so it never pushes the content or gets clipped b
- [Product Listing](docs/components/product-listing.md): A listing of products: the cards take the whole width of a row and the listing always shows whole rows. After the first rows come a "Show more" button (the defa
- [Product Card](docs/components/product-card.md): The card of a product in a listing: a picture with a badge and a heart over it, the price, the title in two lines, the rating and one line of meta (for example 
- [Progress Bar](docs/components/progress-bar.md): A linear progress indicator
- [Rating Display](docs/components/rating-display.md): Shows a rating as stars, for example an average score. It cannot be changed
- [Segmented Control](docs/components/segmented-control.md): A control for switching between a few exclusive options
- [Skeleton](docs/components/skeleton.md): A placeholder shown while content loads
- [Spinner](docs/components/spinner.md): A loading indicator
- [Status](docs/components/status.md): Tells the user the state of a view: nothing to show, information, success, a warning or an error. It fills the container it is in, in width and height, and cent
- [Table](docs/components/table.md): Tabular data with sorting, selection and several looks
- [Tabs](docs/components/tabs.md): Switches between related views: the row of tabs and the panel under it. A row wider than its container scrolls, with slide buttons and a fade at the edges from 
- [Toast](docs/components/toast.md): Shows brief notifications: a message, an optional action and a close button. Call `useToast()` to add one
- [Token](docs/components/token.md): A chip for selection or indication: a Base UI Toggle with a size, a status and slots. With `action` it is a button, removable or plain
- [Token Group](docs/components/token-group.md): A group of chips: a title, a wrapping container and a caption or an error. With `options` a managed set (the value is an array of the selected values), with `ch
- [Tooltip](docs/components/tooltip.md): A short hint on hover or focus. It is never shown on a touch screen (no hover there), so keep the information available some other way

## Tools

- [Radius Check](docs/tools/radius-check.md): Checks that nested rounded corners are concentric: the inner radius is the outer radius minus the inset
- [Size Balance](docs/tools/size-balance.md): Measures a screen from the 16px body text: one ladder of text sizes and one of control heights, so nothing is small here and too big there
- [Spacing Balance](docs/tools/spacing-balance.md): Checks proximity: things that belong together sit closer than things that do not
